rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday Cantonese word for a dictionary.

example.jyutping: ni1 bun2 zi6 din2 gei2 hou2 jung6

rows.note: A speaker uses this more formal term for a word-focused or language dictionary, especially in writing.

example.english: This dictionary includes many Cantonese words.
example.traditional: 呢本詞典收錄咗好多粵語詞。
example.jyutping: ni1 bun2 ci4 din2 sau1 luk6 zo2 hou2 do1 jyut6 jyu5 ci4

rows.note: Use this for a dictionary devoted to a particular specialized subject, such as law or medicine.

example.english: This specialized dictionary is very useful for people studying law.
example.traditional: 呢本專科詞典對學法律嘅人好有用。
example.jyutping: ni1 bun2 zyun1 fo1 ci4 din2 deoi3 hok6 faat3 leot6 ge3 jan4 hou2 jau5 jung6
